# Paula Ambrosio Interiors

> Paula Ambrosio Interiors is a Miami-based luxury interior design studio founded and led by Paula Ambrosio (Founder & Principal Designer). The studio creates sophisticated residential and hospitality interiors across Miami and South Florida and for international clients, offering full-service interior design, turnkey interior design, luxury residential design and hospitality design — delivered from concept through procurement, installation and final styling.

## About

- [About the Studio](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/about): Paula Ambrosio, the studio's philosophy and design approach.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/faq): Direct answers about the founder, services, service area, process and project types.
- [Contact](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/contact): Start a project inquiry.

## Services

- [Turnkey Interior Design in Miami](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/turnkey-interior-design-miami): Complete move-in-ready interiors — design, procurement, installation and styling as one managed project.
- [Luxury Residential Interior Design in Miami](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/luxury-residential-interior-design-miami): High-end interiors for luxury homes, waterfront residences, condominiums, penthouses, renovations and new construction.
- [Hospitality Interior Design in Miami](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/hospitality-interior-design-miami): Guest-focused commercial environments — boutique hospitality, lounges, wellness and beauty spaces.

## Selected Projects

- [HOME DR — Coconut Grove, Miami](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/projects/home-dr): Custom architectural residence with lighting masterplan and custom fireplace.
- [HOME FL — Star Island, Miami Beach](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/projects/home-fl): Waterfront custom estate with interior architecture and curated art.
- [HOME IT — Williams Island, Aventura](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/projects/home-it): Family waterfront residence with bespoke children's suites.
- [HOME KD — Pinecrest, Miami](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/projects/home-kd): Modern custom residence with custom millwork and curated lighting.
- [HOME S — Brickell, Miami](https://paulaambrosiointeriors.com/projects/home-s): Brickell high-rise delivered entirely turnkey.
